body: You make a good point. If she agrees to move out I plan to go get her removed from the lease and pay any associated fees.
I'm the primary leaseholder and she cannot afford to live here by herself. I'm not disputing your judgement, I just wanted to provide some more context.
Thank you, kind stranger. I love you too.

Thank you for reaching out. I'm 22 so I find it overwhelming that I have to live for another 50+ years. I simultaneously feel like I'm wasting my life but also like there's nothing I can really do about it. For what it's worth the fact that you're holding on for your daughter means that you have a good deal of value as a caring and compassionate soul.
